download_s2ef_data: download s2ef dataset for a specified split like 200k, 2M, or all using the CLI
download_is2re_data: download the is2re dataset for structure reconstruction tasks using the CLI
run_get_data: run get_data to download, extract, and preprocess s2ef or is2re datasets to a directory
run_uncompress_data: run uncompress_data to decompress a compressed s2ef data directory using the uncompress module
run_preprocess_data: run preprocess_data to transform uncompressed s2ef data into LMDB format at an output path
